_help: Short excerpts from public Goodreads reviews, word for word, with the reviewer's display name. Check they are still up with: python3 tools/pull-reviews.py --check . Remove any entry a reviewer asks to have taken down.

reviews.name: Jan
reviews.text: There was no time for dreaming but for the life of me I couldn't stop thinking about this book.

reviews.name: Melluvsbooks

reviews.name: Sarah
reviews.text: So while I thought it was a mistake to buy this book, in the end it was a great decision.

reviews.name: BeaC
reviews.text: From the very first page, I was hooked by the tension and the raw journey Evie is on.

reviews.name: Katie
reviews.text: I love Evie and West, and the angst and tension between them was unreal, making everything that much hotter.

reviews.name: Kimberly

reviews.name: Johanna
reviews.text: Plot was intriguing and intense and exciting and well paced.

reviews.name: Michele
reviews.text: I always love it when I find a book that I just can’t put down.

reviews.name: Shannon
reviews.text: So many intense feelings and emotions were going through me as I read, I was completely sucked into Regan's world.

reviews.name: Karen Lee
reviews.text: Anyone looking for a good book with a great story, this is for you.

reviews.text: I am completely hooked on this series, Ashley has created such fantastic characters I cannot wait to see what is in store for them in OtherSide Of Fear, that little tease at the end of this book was amazing!

reviews.name: Jessika
reviews.text: Another phenomenal read I’m obsessed with this series.

reviews.text: It’s brilliant, thrilling, beautiful, and terrifying all at the same time.

reviews.name: Angela
reviews.text: This is a terrific ending to an awesome series.
